_note: Shows process-pipeline and locations-relief. Ledgerline Processing is a fictional company; every figure is sample data.

site.title: Ledgerline Processing | Invoice and document processing
site.description: Ledgerline Processing captures, checks and posts supplier invoices for finance teams, from offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang and Manila.

data.title: Supplier invoices captured, checked and *posted*
data.lead: Ledgerline Processing runs accounts payable for finance teams: we capture every invoice, match it to the order, route it for approval and post it to your ledger.

photo.alt: Invoices and a calculator on an accountant's desk

cards.title: Supplier invoices
cards.text: Paper, PDF and e-invoices captured, coded to your chart of accounts and matched to orders.

cards.title: Expense claims
cards.text: Receipts checked against your expense policy before they reach a manager.

cards.title: Payment runs
cards.text: Payment files prepared for your bank and checked against approved invoices.

cards.title: Supplier records
cards.text: New supplier forms, bank detail changes and statement reconciliation.

head.title: How an invoice moves through our team
head.lead: Each invoice passes five stations. Anything that fails a check goes back to the station that can fix it.

stages.title: Intake
stages.text: Invoices arrive by email, supplier portal or scanned post into one queue.

stages.title: Capture and coding
stages.text: Header and line data are captured and coded to your accounts.

stages.title: Matching
stages.text: Each invoice is matched to its purchase order and goods receipt.

stages.title: Second check
stages.text: A second person checks amounts, tax and supplier bank details.

stages.title: Posting
stages.text: Approved invoices are posted to your ledger and filed with their audit trail.

head.title: Three offices, one team
head.lead: Our head office in Ho Chi Minh City runs the process; Da Nang and Manila add capacity and English-language supplier support.

data.title: Send us a month of *invoice volumes*
data.text: We reply with a staffing plan, a price per invoice and a start date.

data.blurb: Ledgerline Processing captures, checks and posts supplier invoices for finance teams.
